California, US Sidy Camara celebrates winning the men’s shortboard competition at an event called A Great Day in the Stoke, the largest annual gathering of Black surfers in the world, at Huntington Beach.
Bali, Indonesia A man displays a traditional mask during Tumpek Wayang, a sacred Balinese Hindu holiday honouring local arts and culture.

New York City, US A cosplayer dressed as Marge Simpson emerges from the subway on her way to the city’s Comic-Con event.
Aerial view of a crowd catching falling people during a collapsing human tower in Tarragona.

Paris, France Protesters demonstrating against what they call an overcrowded, ill-equipped and understaffed education system gather around the Monument à la République in Paris. High school students blockaded schools and marched through cities across France again this week and promised to continue their campaign against the poor state of the national education system.

Nantes, France Protesters clash with gendarmes as high school and university students attend a demonstration as part of a nationwide day of protests and blockades to demand better school conditions. The prime minister, Sébastien Lecornu, said the government would propose amendments to the 2027 budget to ‘translate some of the students’ demands into concrete measures, particularly regarding teacher replacements’.

Toulouse, France Protesters shield themselves from teargas fired by riot police. Sabrine Kharbach, from a students’ association, said the protests would last ‘for as long as €10bn hasn’t been put on the table’ , the amount students and some leftwing politicians have said needs to be urgently invested in France’s schools.
Reim, Israel An Israeli woman pays her respects on the third anniversary of the Hamas attacks at the Nova festival site in Reim.
Gaza City Palestinians inspect the destruction caused by an Israeli airstrike that hit a residential building in the Sabra area of Gaza City.

Aqraba, West Bank Palestinian men run after Israeli forces open fire while they are being chased away from picking olives in Aqraba in the Israeli-occupied West Bank. Every year, settlers attack Palestinian farmers trying to harvest their olives – an economic lifeline for the beleaguered Palestinian economy – with few legal consequences. This harvest season has been particularly violent as the Israeli elections approach at the end of the month.

Asira al-Qibliya, West Bank Palestinian farmers try to extinguish fires on their land after Israeli soldiers fired teargas at them as they harvested their olives, resulting in the dry fields catching fire, in the village of Asira al-Qibliya. Armed Israeli settlers beat Jaafar Ashtiyeh , the photographer who took this image, in the presence of Israeli soldiers, hospitalising him, as he covered the settler violence against the olive farmers. Ashtiyeh, a 58-year-old veteran photographer for AFP in Palestine, was assaulted by a group of settlers despite him being marked as press.

Tehran, Iran Volunteers attend training at the Jan-Fada military training camp in Imam Hussein Square. Leaders in California denounced Donald Trump as ‘reckless’ and ‘deranged’ after the US president suggested Iran could ‘take out’ Los Angeles and San Diego , two liberal cities in the blue state that have been frequent targets of his administration.

Grand Island, Nebraska Natalie Harp, an executive assistant to Donald Trump, brings out an executive order for him to sign during a campaign rally at Pinnacle Bank Expo Center in Grand Island. At the rally on Monday night, Trump told supporters he hoped to see a ‘tremendous victory’ in the fast-approaching November midterm elections. He then suggested high prices due to the war with Iran were a ‘small price to pay for keeping the world safe – keeping our country safe’.
Arabian Sea US Navy sailors onboard an MV-22 Osprey travel to the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS George Washington in the Arabian Sea.

Arabian Sea Night-time operations continue on the flight deck of the USS George Washington in the Arabian Sea . The aircraft carrier, capable of carrying more than 5,000 personnel, is enforcing a US naval blockade against Iran and providing cover for commercial vessels transiting the strait of Hormuz.

San Diego, California Alexander Adkins kisses his wife, McKenzie Adkins, as she holds Declan, their 10-week-old baby, after his return home on USS Abraham Lincoln . The Lincoln first left San Diego last November with an expected return date sometime in the spring. But as the US and Israel launched a war with Iran, the aircraft carrier was diverted to the Middle East , extending the deployment for the roughly 5,000 sailors and marines onboard.

Kyiv, Ukraine Rescuers work outside a damaged five-storey residential building after a Russian drone attack in Kyiv. The city has come under near constant attack from Russia’s new jet-powered drones in recent weeks, as an intensifying strike campaign increasingly disrupts everyday life in the capital and threatens to leave the city without power this winter.

Kyiv, Ukraine A Russian jet-powered drone strikes one of Kyiv’s bridges. If Moscow succeeds in seriously damaging Kyiv’s bridges, it could create a logistical nightmare for the city of 3 million people , whose crossings over the Dnipro were last destroyed on a large scale as Nazi German forces retreated in 1943. More than a third of residents live on the left bank, while much of the city’s employment and infrastructure is concentrated on the right.

Banyuasin, Indonesia A resident throws water in an attempt to extinguish a wildfire near a residential area in Banyuasin. The Indonesian government has been accused of gross negligence in a class action lawsuit over its handling of wildfires that have cloaked large parts of south-east Asia in a toxic haze, shuttered schools and caused a spike in respiratory illnesses.

Durban, South Africa Police assist residents in taking cover after clashes erupt between protesters and foreign nationals in Durban. Several vehicles were set alight during the confrontation amid tensions over undocumented immigration and foreign nationals.

Soweto, South Africa A looter removes goods from a convenience store after clashes between residents and foreign nationals in Soweto. The tensions over migration were reignited by a court order that the government must restart processing asylum applications.
Delhi, India A demonstrator jumps out of a bus window broken by detained protesters during a rally against the alleged assault of female protesters and journalists by Delhi police.
New York City, US Cosplayers take photographs during the opening day of New York Comic-Con at the Jacob Javits Center in Manhattan.
